snippet.title: Peer Ka Din Itna Khaas Kyun? | Sahih Muslim 1162 #shorts
snippet.description:
Aaj Peer ka din hai. Kya aap jaante hain, yeh din itna khaas kyun hai?

Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) se Peer ke roze ke baare mein poocha gaya, to farmaya (Abu Qatada Ansari Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat):
«ذَاكَ يَوْمٌ وُلِدْتُ فِيهِ وَيَوْمٌ بُعِثْتُ أَوْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيَّ فِيهِ»
"Yeh woh din hai jis din meri wiladat hui, aur jis din mujhe nabuwwat mili ya mujh par wahi utri."

Reference
• Sahih Muslim 1162: https://sunnah.com/muslim:1162b
• Sahih Muslim 1162 (short wording: "fihi wulidtu wa fihi unzila 'alayya"): https://sunnah.com/muslim:1162e

Yaani apni wiladat ke din ko, aap ne roze aur shukr se yaad kiya. Aaj roza rakh sakein to rakhein, aur kasrat se durood shareef parhein. Comment mein durood shareef likhein. Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
